products.calciteTitle: Calcite — the main cause of scale
products.calciteDescPart1: Calcite, the main cause of scale, is the most common form of calcium carbonate and occurs naturally as an ingredient of chalk, limestone and marble. Water passing over and permeating through such rocks dissolves calcite; when this water subsequently flows through a water system the calcite precipitates out to form a very hard scale on surfaces.
products.calciteDescPart2: When hard water is heated, or evaporation takes place, the problems are exacerbated. Calcite forms ever growing layers of rock-like deposits until eventually pipes, jets and equipment become totally blocked. The problem increases as the water gets hotter.
products.scaleBuilds: Scale builds up inside pipes and fittings, shrinking the bore over time.
products.scaleThicker: The thicker the scale, the harder the system works and the more fuel it burns.
products.scaleHotter: Hotter water accelerates scale growth, so heating is where the damage starts.
products.scaleReturns: Once removed, scale keeps returning unless the water itself is treated.
products.scaleCostDesc: Scale is rarely one big failure. It is a steady drain on efficiency, running costs and equipment life.
products.wastedEnergyDesc: Just one eighth of an inch of scale reduces heating efficiency by 25%.
products.expensiveDescalingDesc: It is very expensive to remove scale from pipes and boilers.
products.costlyDowntimeDesc: Higher warranty costs, costly down-time and higher cleaning agent costs.
products.blockedShowersDesc: Shower and plumbing blockages, reduced efficiency and higher energy costs.
products.prematureFailureDesc: Premature & unexpected failure, higher maintenance and more time spent cleaning.
products.moreSoapDesc: Hard water wastes soap, detergent and shampoo, raising everyday running costs.
products.hiw3Stage: 3-Stage — Electrolysis, Electronic Frequency with Permanent Magnet, Electromagnetic
products.hiwStage1Desc: The process of induced ionization is taken to its ultimate stage of cathode and anode, breaking down hard water mineral bonds and initiating the transformation of scale-causing minerals.
products.hiwStage2Desc: A frequency modulated (FM) waveform within the audio frequency (AF) bandwidth, combined with a permanent magnet. It alters the crystalline structure of hard water minerals, converting them into microscopic 2–4 micron crystals.
products.hiwStage3Desc: The principles of magneto hydrodynamics (MHD) applied through a patented signal passed through a coil wrapped around the pipe to be treated, ensuring complete conditioning of the water.
products.srSubtitle: Rock-hard calcite is not removed by force — it is broken down at particle level, so it can never build up again.
products.srNotePart1: It is this changed size, modified charge and crystalline shape that has the first two beneficial properties for the reduction of scale. The
products.srNotePart3: and will not coagulate or precipitate and form scale in the same way as untreated calcium carbonate nuclei would.
products.srNotePart4: This process is so effective that the water has been found to feel and behave like chemically softened water.
products.srNotePart5: The presence of the large crystalline shapes disrupts the equilibrium between the fluid and any existing scale. Smaller particles in general dissolve more easily, so the larger particles will have reduced the levels of calcite in solution.
products.srNotePart6: Hence, existing scale deposited by precipitation will soften and gradually be absorbed into solution and flow out of the system. In areas of still water, e.g. tanks etc., the soft scale would settle to the bottom and could then be removed simply by flushing.
products.srLongerPart1a: It has been established that the physiochemical process already described is more efficient because the signal energy is
products.srLongerPart1c: . By changing the signal field at high audio frequencies, unique to Jaldoot, the energy imparted to the nuclei is considerably accelerated.
products.srLongerPart2a: An important property of Jaldoot processed water is that the charged crystalline shape growth will remain in that state for
products.srLongerPart2c: . Thus in stored water systems the effect is much longer lasting than other ionization methods, retarding the reversion back to the smaller nuclei structures that are readily precipitated.
products.srShapeDesc: Angular calcite turns into rounded 2–4 micron crystals that no longer stick together.
products.srScaleSoftensDesc: Deposits break equilibrium, dissolve and go back into solution instead of growing.
products.srFlushesDesc: In tanks and still water the soft scale settles and is removed by a simple flush.

products.buzzzapDesc: The most popular theories hold that positively phototactic insects are drawn to lights because they act like a navigational guide. Many insects find their way by keeping a natural light source, such as the sun or the moon, at a constant angle. Using the same principle, a UV light with a frequency that attracts more than 1800 different flying insects was designed. The insects tend to cross the electric wire mesh around the UV light and get electrocuted. With the use of a solar PV panel to charge the battery, a high tech electronic high voltage circuit is used for the functioning of the system.
